notes: This portable C++ TCK pair uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard library, and adapter-supplied FOM, standard MIM, provider package, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. It resolves every Table 7 S-designated leaf from the pinned 2025 MIM, observes service-identified reports for the parameter-bearing and parameterless federation requests, and checks that these scoped RTI-originated report interactions have empty user tags and are not timestamped. This is partial evidence for the broader §11.4.1 no-metadata rule, not a test of every RTI-originated interaction, attribute update, or object deletion. It uses no provider-specific names, headers, registries, or internal state and makes no conformance claim.
